name: MouseAndAudioIntro
en: What counts as using the PC.

name: SettingsAndLog
where: Extras tab, the heading over the settings file, log size, save and load, welcome, reset and remove rows

name: WhenLocking
where: Extras tab, under Locking: what SteppedOut does when it locks the PC by itself at the lock time
why: When it's time to lock became At the lock time on the Locking tab (R9.1, R9.2)

name: WhenLockingDetail
en: Only when SteppedOut locks the PC by itself
ar: Only when SteppedOut locks the PC by itself
where: Extras tab, the line under When it's time to lock: Lock now, the shortcut and Win+L only lock
why: When it's time to lock became At the lock time on the Locking tab (R9.1, R9.2)

name: LockOnly
where: At the lock time list (Locking tab), the first choice and the default: only the lock

name: LockScreenOff
en: Lock and turn off the screen
where: At the lock time list (Locking tab): the lock, then the screens off

name: LockSleep
where: At the lock time list (Locking tab): the lock, then the PC goes to sleep once the away actions are done

name: UnderPixels
where: Ignore tiny mouse movements list: Under 3, 5 and 10 pixels, and a number typed with Custom… or set in the file; {0} is a whole number of pixels, 2 or more

name: UnderOnePixel
where: Ignore tiny mouse movements list, when 1 is typed with Custom…

name: PixelsCount
where: Custom… box for tiny mouse movements: the range under the box and the word after it; {0} is 2 or more

name: OnePixel
where: Custom… box for tiny mouse movements: the range From 1 pixel to 50 pixels, and the word after the box holding 1

name: PercentCount
where: How loud sound must be to count: a level typed with Custom… or set in the file (4%, 0.5%), and the Custom… box's range and sign; {0} is a number
row: How loud sound must be to count

name: KilobytesCount
where: Log size list: 256 KB, 512 KB and a size typed with Custom…, and the Custom… box's range and unit; {0} is a whole number

name: MegabytesCount
where: Log size list: 1 MB, 4 MB, and a size in whole megabytes typed with Custom…; {0} is a whole number

name: PixelsFieldName
where: screen reader name of the Custom… box for tiny mouse movements; {0} is the row's title

name: PercentFieldName
en: {0}, as a percent of full volume
where: screen reader name of the Custom… box for the loudness; {0} is the row's title
row: How loud sound must be to count

name: KilobytesFieldName
where: screen reader name of the Custom… box for the log size; {0} is the row's title

name: CustomRangeOf
where: Custom… box for pixels, a percent or a log size, before anything is typed; {0} and {1} are the shortest and longest with their unit (1 pixel, 50 pixels)

name: CustomClampedOf
en: Only {0} to {1} work, so it uses {2}.
ar: اكتب قيمة من {0} إلى {1}. القيمة المستخدمة الآن: {2}.
where: Custom… box for pixels, a percent or a log size, after a number out of range; {0} and {1} are the range's ends, {2} the nearest, each with its unit

name: CustomNotANumberOf
en: Type a number. Until then it uses {0}.
where: Custom… box for pixels, a percent or a log size, while it holds no number; {0} is the value in use with its unit

name: LogSize
where: Extras tab, under Settings and log: how big the log gets

name: LogSizeDetail
en: At this size the log starts over, keeping one older copy
ar: عند بلوغ هذا الحجم، يبدأ سجل جديد وتُحفظ نسخة واحدة من السجل السابق
where: Extras tab, the line under Log size

name: SaveAndLoad
where: Extras tab, under Settings and log, with Save to file… and Load from file…

name: SaveAndLoadDetail
en: Keep a copy in a file, or load settings from one
ar: يمكنك حفظ نسخة من الإعدادات في ملف، أو استيرادها من ملف
where: Extras tab, the line under Save and load settings

name: SaveToFile
where: Extras tab, Save and load settings: button that opens Windows' Save window

name: LoadFromFile
where: Extras tab, Save and load settings: button that opens Windows' Open window

name: SettingsFiles
where: Windows' Save and Open windows from the Extras tab: the kind of file listed, before (*.json)

name: LoadCantUse
en: This file can't be used. It isn't a SteppedOut settings file, or it's damaged.
ar: هذا ليس ملف إعدادات SteppedOut صالحًا. لم تتغير الإعدادات.
where: message after Load from file… picks a file that does not load as settings; nothing changes

name: LoadTooOld
en: This file is from a version of SteppedOut before 1.0, so it can't be used.
ar: هذا الملف من إصدار أقدم من SteppedOut 1.0، فلا يمكنك استخدامه. لم تتغير الإعدادات.
where: message after Load from file… picks a settings file from before 1.0; nothing changes

name: LoadCantOpen
ar: تعذر فتح هذا الملف. لم تتغير الإعدادات.
where: message after Load from file… picks a file Windows will not let it read, or one far too big; nothing changes

name: LoadPartly
en: Some settings in this file couldn't be read, so they're back to their defaults.
ar: تعذر قراءة بعض القيم، فعادت إلى قيمها الافتراضية. تم استخدام باقي الملف.
where: message after Load from file… loads a file with some values it could not read; the rest of the file is used

name: SaveCantWrite
en: The settings couldn't be saved to this file.
ar: تعذر حفظ الإعدادات في هذا الملف، لأن Windows لا يسمح بالكتابة فيه.
where: message after Save to file… when Windows will not let it write the file

name: ShowWelcomeAgain
where: Extras tab, under Settings and log, with a Show button that closes the settings and opens the welcome window

name: ShowWelcomeAgainDetail
en: Go through the first setup again
ar: تظهر خطوات الإعداد الأول مرة أخرى، كما عند أول تشغيل
where: Extras tab, the line under Show the welcome again

name: ResetAll
where: Extras tab, under Settings and log, with Reset…

name: ResetAllDetail
en: Go back to the settings SteppedOut started with
where: Extras tab, the line under Reset all settings

name: ResetButton
where: Extras tab, Reset all settings: button that asks first

name: ResetTitle
ar: هل تريد إعادة تعيين كل الإعدادات؟
where: the question Reset… asks, its title

name: ResetBody
en: Every setting goes back to how it was when you first started SteppedOut. Your language stays.
ar: تعود كل إعدادات SteppedOut إلى قيمها الافتراضية، وتبقى اللغة كما هي.
where: the question Reset… asks, under its title

name: Reset
where: the question Reset… asks: the button that resets, beside Cancel

name: RemoveFiles
where: Extras tab, the last row under Settings and log, with Remove…

name: RemoveFilesDetail
en: Delete its settings, log and counts from this PC, then quit
ar: حذف الإعدادات والسجل وبيانات اليوم من هذا الكمبيوتر، ثم إنهاء التطبيق
where: Extras tab, the line under Remove SteppedOut's files

name: RemoveButton
where: Extras tab, Remove SteppedOut's files: button that asks first

name: RemoveTitle
where: the question Remove… asks, its title

name: RemoveBody
en: This deletes SteppedOut's settings, log and today's counts on this PC, turns off Start with Windows, and quits SteppedOut. It can't be undone.
ar: سيتم حذف الإعدادات والسجل وبيانات اليوم، وإيقاف "البدء مع Windows"، ثم إنهاء SteppedOut. لا يمكنك التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.
where: the question Remove… asks, under its title

name: RemoveAndQuit
where: the question Remove… asks: the button that deletes the files and quits, beside Cancel
